label: graceful failover
type: manually initiated failover performed while the cluster is healthy and all active and replica vBuckets are available, so that no data is lost. Completes only after a subsequent rebalance.
evidence: It is manually initiated when the entire cluster is in a healthy state, and all active and replica vBuckets on all nodes are available.
There are two basic types: _graceful_ and _hard_.
This indicates the graceful failover has successfully completed, but an additional rebalance is required to complete the reduction of the cluster to one node.
note: Promoted with server:hard-failover as a two-member enumeration under server:failover; both cross the bar on their own recurrence, so no family exception was needed.
